opening.argument: The video directs viewers to join BitConnect, fund an account with Bitcoin, buy BCC, and place those tokens into an investment. It gives explicit instructions to “deposit maybe even just $100” and says “you need to buy BCC.” The process then leads to an earnings calculation tied to a BitConnect lending step, while the presentation promotes unusually high projected returns, including a stated 307% return and high or potentially guaranteed interest. It further claims, “So you will make 370$ profit with this invesment of 299 days.” These are promotional funding and return claims; the available evidence does not establish that any transaction, payout, or loss was completed.
